Planar surfaces appear to undergo extreme shearing forces, warping into crystalline shards that resist collapse while simultaneously dissolving into particulate mist. Geometry becomes recursively complex, forming self-similar patterns that are visibly pulled toward an undefined central point by powerful, unseen gravitational forces. The entire scene is a dynamic spectacle of continuous structural failure and reformation.
